verdict.rationale: Browserbase is an API platform for browser agents, so issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents scoped, permission-limited or per-agent API keys. The only credential mention, the llms.txt description of 'one API key' giving the agent everything it needs, points to a single broad key rather than least-privilege scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
